name: raw-does-not-close-chunk-stream
description: RAW stands aside from chunk assembly, so an id-less continuation after one still continues the open stream
kill: make RAW close the open chunk lane, the way CUSTOM does

dotnet.intentional: GAP, not a design difference: EventStreamConverter has no case for TEXT_MESSAGE_CHUNK or TOOL_CALL_CHUNK, so a chunk stream falls through to the pass-through branch. Nothing is expanded into a message and none of the chunk-stream rules are enforced. Pinned here so the gap cannot widen or close unnoticed; alignment tracked separately. The RAW aside cannot close a chunk stream that was never opened, so the rule this fixture states is untested on this lane.
